name: magic-link
title: Magic Links
description: Passwordless sign-in with single-use links sent by email (optionally sign-up too)

env.description: How long a sign-in link stays valid
true = unknown emails get an account when they click the link

notes: The sign-in page gets an "Email me a sign-in link" option.
Two-step verification (TOTP / email codes) still applies after the link is clicked.
